title: One [lng, lat] pair parser and one point type for both routing providers
goal: The duplicated coordinate-pair parser is one function
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "ok to all" (accepts proposals of the shared-asset review, coordinator:F-016-T06 and T08); same message: "nerv and all modules will need to work with Italian".

`parseLngLatPair` is written twice, in server/ors-provider.ts:57 and server/osrm-provider.ts:55, and `GeoPoint` (src/app/core/place.ts:6) and `MapPoint` (src/app/maps/map-provider.ts:6) are two names for one shape; after this step there is one parser and one point type, with the providers' fixture tests unchanged (inside one project, so the coordinator's rule for shared code applies, not blocks)
A failing test first: a malformed pair is rejected the same way by both providers
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
